copy.curiosityHook: With competing factions clashing over the ultimate fate of human existence, what choice can a fractured mind make under siege?
copy.description: As SEELE launches an all-out assault on NERV to eliminate the Evas before Gendo can trigger the Human Instrumentality Project, a shattered Shinji is pushed to his absolute brink with humanity's fate in his hands.
copy.vibeSummary: Heavy, immersive, and fast-paced; a solitary apocalyptic drama defined by urgent action and psychological tension.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Hideaki Anno and Kazuya Tsurumaki, this relentless 87-minute animated drama fuses intense sci-fi combat with an unsparing, high-stakes psychological breakdown.

allowedMaterial: Targeting the Evas to stop Gendo's Human Instrumentality Project plans
Shinji pushed to the limits of his sanity while deciding humanity's fate
